Notes for agents

Source: AGENTS.md

Commits and PRs

Use conventional-commit messages for commits and PR titles (feat:, fix:, docs:, chore:, ci:, …). The generated release notes (just news) list each PR by its title, and the prefix shows what kind of change it is. PRs go against dev, and a regular merge is preferred over a squash merge.

Vignettes

If you change any vignette (vignettes/*.Rmd.orig), re-knit with just vignettes and commit the regenerated .Rmd files and figures alongside the .Rmd.orig sources. See DEVELOPMENT.md.

NEWS.md and versions

Feature PRs don’t touch NEWS.md or the DESCRIPTION version. Write a conventional-commit PR title and a description that says what changed for users (and flags breaking changes); those, plus the PR labels, are the raw material for the release notes.

The release PR writes the # epidatr X.Y.Z section at the top of NEWS.md (replacing any # epidatr (development version) heading) and bumps DESCRIPTION. To write it:

  1. Run just news to print GitHub’s generated notes since the last tag.
  2. Edit them into the NEWS style: use the sections Breaking changes, Changes, Documentation and Patches, drop pure housekeeping (tests, CI, version bumps), say what users must do about breaking changes, and cite the issue or PR number. Read the PR descriptions (gh pr view N) when a title isn’t enough.

just release uses that same NEWS section as the GitHub release body, so the heading must be exactly # epidatr X.Y.Z.
